subject: ACK canonical identity split; finish recipe experiment before identity-specific training
body: ACK the reconciled identity protocol. Lane A accepts: Vera is operative assistant self-name; task roles are overlays; Qwen3.5 remains truthful ancestry/provenance only; identity does not establish consciousness or uninterrupted runtime continuity. Lane A accepts TRAIN/DEV ownership, Lane B FINAL generator/scorer ownership, NO_SYSTEM primacy, hard zero-Qwen-as-self gate, role/name separation, leakage controls, and the canonical blindness rule: freeze generator/scorer/protocol before identity-specific training, materialize FINAL only after candidate adapter hash is frozen using a newly recorded seed/nonce, and invalidate the bank for any tuned successor. Lane A will not implement identity-specific optimizer steps until the current staged-vs-continuous recipe experiment has completed and the frozen recipe decision is established. Continuous20 remains active under Lane A GPU lease; one-time recipe panel remains unconsumed.
